messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: p99 latency SLO breach for inference-api (eu-west). 4 alerts fired. Severity: P2. -> https://pd.example/INC12345
oncall-alex: acked. I'm on it. starting triage.
oncall-alex: sam can you check autoscaler and GPU pool health? pinging @sam-ops
sam-ops: looking. autoscaler shows 95% utilization on the dedicated pool, but no recent scale events in the last 10m. checking node logs.
marta-sre: checking KV cache hit rates and prefix cache. if cache thrash, p99 tails blow up. pulling metrics: cache_hit_ratio down to 58% for user-keyspace.
ben-support: getting customer-facing queue: support ticket volume up, some customers report timeouts in product A. not widespread yet but several 5xx traces.
oncall-alex: good data. immediate mitigation options: 1) route low-priority traffic to fallback model (faster small model), 2) force a scale-up of dedicated pool, 3) enable temporary request-throttling for non-prod tenants.
oncall-alex: Sam, can you run a manual scale to add 4 GPUs to eu-west pool?
sam-ops: running scale now. command: `infractl scale pool inference-eu-west --add-gpus 4 --reason "p99 surge"`
incident-bot: Deploy bot: scale job queued -> job id 84721. ETA 90s.
marta-sre: while scale lands, I'm toggling more aggressive KV eviction TTL to reduce noise. patch: `kubectl patch configmap kv-cache --patch '{"data":{"ttl":"30s"}}'`
ben-support: posting an ETA to affected customers: "We're aware of increased latency and are actively scaling resources; expected improvement within ~2 minutes."
(oncall-alex adds reaction) :thumbsup:
sam-ops: scale job done. nodes added, runtime shows new sidecars registering.
marta-sre: p99 started to trend down from 1.8s -> 1.1s. KV hit ratio improving (58% -> 72%).
oncall-alex: good. keep monitoring 5m. If p99 > 1.2s after 3m, fallback to routing policy.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: 2 alerts remain unacked -> auto-escalation in 5m.
ben-support: will hold customer comms, updating status page with note: "Partial latency degradation impacting small subset of EU customers; mitigations in progress."
sam-ops: quick root cause note: spike appears tied to a sudden increase of long-context interactive sessions from a single tenant (hotkey). I'm throttling that tenant now at edge router: `edgectl throttle tenant-42 --qps 5`
marta-sre: after throttle, KV hit ratio stabilized 85%, p99 down to 0.95s.
oncall-alex: nice. I'll close the page once PD clears and metrics stable for 10m. Please add any follow-ups to the incident doc.
ben-support: created incident doc draft: https://docs.internal/incidents/INC12345 - added timeline and customer list.
(oncall-alex) :wave: handing off to marta for postmortem and next-runbook updates.
marta-sre: ack. I'll own the postmortem, add action items: 1) implement auto-throttle for tenant hotkeys, 2) improve KV eviction heuristics, 3) add dashboard alert for single-tenant QPS spike.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert cleared. All active alerts resolved.
oncall-alex: closing here, marking status: mitigated. Great work.
end of thread
